blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution is seeking protective and special measures for 55 witnesses who are set to testify in the crimes against humanity cases against former President Rodrigo Duterte. Meanwhile, the outcome of the US midterm elections could lead to a drop of as much as P13.50 per liter in local fuel prices. Vice President Sara Duterte, for her part, is scheduled to visit Hong Kong from Nov. 6 to 8, with the Office of the Vice President saying she will personally shoulder the expenses./dp READ: ICC protection sought […]...
